chunks: Ṣafwān narrated from Qutaybah al-Aʿshā who said:

I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him) say, 'You made enemies of your fathers, children, and wives for our sake, and your reward for that is with Allah. The time when you will be most in need of our love is when the soul reaches here,' and he pointed towards his neck.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Ahl al-Bayt's love at the time of death?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Kitab al-Zuhd*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the profound spiritual cost of *al-wala'* (loyalty) to the Ahl al-Bayt, where believers often endure separation from their own kin. He emphasizes that the moment of death (*al-hadl*) is the critical juncture where divine reward transitions into the practical necessity of the Ahl al-Bayt's intercession and love. This underscores the Shia theological concept that love for the Imams is not merely devotional but essential for salvation at the hour of reckoning.

en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 11.Ṣafwān narrated from Qutaybah al-Aʿshā who said, “

I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh (a) say, ‘You made enemies of your fathers, children, and wives for our sake and your reward for that is with Allah. The time when you will be most in need of our love is when the soul reaches here,’ and he pointed towards his neck.”
